posts.text: Dear candidate, congratulations! You are shortlisted for the post of Assistant Manager at Tata Consultancy. Your offer letter is ready. Kindly transfer the refundable laptop security amount of Rs 6500 to the account given below within 24 hours to confirm.

posts.text: Part time job for everyone. Rate restaurants on Google Maps and earn 150 per review. Daily withdrawal. Join our Telegram channel and complete 3 free tasks first, then upgrade to VIP level for bigger commission.
posts.note: Task scams pay for a few easy tasks first, then ask you to “upgrade” or deposit money to keep earning.

posts.text: Work from home opportunity. Watch YouTube videos and like them. 50 rupees per like, up to 5000 per day. No investment for first task. Text 'START' on Whats App to begin.
posts.note: Getting paid to like videos is a task scam: the money stops once you’re asked to invest.

flags.title: Asks for ID or bank details

posts.note: Big visa and medical charges paid to an agent, with only a WhatsApp video interview: a typical overseas visa scam.

posts.text: Indian Railways recruitment 2026 through our office. 100% placement guarantee for Group D posts without exam. Contact our coordinator, documents fee 3500 only.
posts.note: Government jobs are filled through official exams, never through a private office or “without exam” for a fee.

posts.text: Earn by investing in our crypto trading tasks. Deposit USDT and get 30 percent returns every week. Work from mobile. Our team will guide you on Telegram.
posts.note: Guaranteed weekly returns on a crypto deposit is an investment scam, not a job.

posts.text: We need data entry staff urgently. You will receive PDF files and have to type them in Word. Payment 18000 per month. Sign the agreement and pay the 2499 processing charge to receive the first project.
posts.note: Data-entry “jobs” that charge a processing fee before the first project are a well-known scam.

flags.title: Asks for ID or bank details

posts.note: Asking for Aadhaar, PAN and your bank statement on WhatsApp before any interview is an identity-theft move.
